svg.title: Four layers
svg.desc: L1 Judgment, the agent: choose between open options and talk with the human. L2 Procedure, the prompt explains: skills and AGENTS.md. L3 Local logic, the code checks: tested CLI, linters, architecture tests. L4 Remote execution, the pipeline executes: CI and pipelines.
